_comment: Template for tests/env.json (gitignored) -- credentials only. The mode configuration (runner_type, backend, url, model, reasoning, temperature, ...) lives in tests/modes.json, which is tracked in git: do not duplicate it here. Only the modes that actually need an Anthropic API key appear below; local modes (backend openai/ollama) and the claude-code modes -- claude-code-local and claude-code-haiku -- need no entry: the CLI authenticates on the Claude Code session, which is also why those modes bill against the subscription and not against API credit.
